'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Walseth LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Walseth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Walseth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
